AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Water: seedbed pits? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Water: seedbed pits.

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming cleaning? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Good Grooming cleaning.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Good Grooming cleaning.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Good Grooming cleaning.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Good Grooming cleaning.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Crop Products.

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundry: Stain Removal? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundry: Stain Removal.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundry: Stain Removal.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Laundry: Stain Removal.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundry: Stain Removal.

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
